name: smwsprites-parental-big-bertha-underwater
title: Parental Big Bertha (Underwater)
description:
This is the Big Bertha from SMB3 which is rarely seen underwater. She will swim back and forth occasionally "spitting" out a baby Cheep Cheep before sucking it back into her mouth.

This sprite is heavily based on SMB3's code, with some minor changes to the timing of the sprite to allow it to spit the baby out more consistently.

This sprite is not required to be in water to function, and will function normally outside of water.
